usage: icebath-acp [-h] [--version] [--check] [--setup] [--setup-browser]
                   [--yes]

Run Icebath Agent as an ACP stdio server.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --version        Print Icebath version and exit
  --check          Verify ACP dependencies and adapter imports, then exit
  --setup          Run interactive Icebath provider/model setup for ACP
                   terminal auth
  --setup-browser  Prepare PM's pinned Chromium for browser_exec.
  --yes, -y        Accept setup prompts.
